newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid's Ibex-35 powers to all-time high at close.
newsitem.headline: Madrid's Ibex-35 powers to all-time high at close.

text.p: Madrid's blue chip Ibex-35 index added 59.09 points, 1.04 percent, to close at an all-time high of 5,730.03 on Tuesday.
The broad-based Madrid general index rose 4.00 points, or 0.81 percent also to a new high of 498.36.
Gains in some key stocks outstripped the overall index gain, offsetting the effect of losses in other shares, dealers said.
Telefonica rose 1.78 percent to 3,710 pesetas while Endesa added 3.23 percent to 9,910 pesetas.
However dealers warned that a correction was overdue, and should be forthcoming this week.
